# StreamHeaven

> StreamHeaven is a modern, high-definition online streaming web application providing free access to over 1.2 million movies, television series, and anime titles.

## Overview
- Website: https://streamheaven.online
- Tagline: Watch Free Movies, Series & Anime Online
- Core Features: Free movie streaming, full TV series episodes, subbed & dubbed anime, multi-server playback, ad-free streaming player option, user watchlist & watch history cloud synchronization.
- Compatibility: Web browsers (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile), Android APK application, Progressive Web App (PWA) on iOS & desktop.

## Primary Streaming Categories
- Free Movies Online: https://streamheaven.online/ (Hollywood, International, Classics, Action, Comedy, Horror, Sci-Fi, Thriller)
- Free TV Series Online: https://streamheaven.online/ (Popular television shows, complete season episode guides)
- Free Anime Online: https://streamheaven.online/ (Japanese animation, Shonen, Seinen, Isekai, Romance)
- Trending & Top Rated: https://streamheaven.online/ (Live daily trending lists, all-time critically acclaimed films)

## Privacy & Policies
- Privacy Policy: https://streamheaven.online/privacy.html
- Terms & DMCA: Built-in modal viewer for DMCA compliance and copyright inquiries.
